set.body:
Type: implementation task (sub-task of F02.3)
Work key: F02.3.2
Parent: F02.3 (bd-01M4W5P591G5D5048MSJ46BN27)
Plan: docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md (transition table, public API contract), ADR 003 (recovery)

Scope: /v1/labs, /v1/projects and /v1/datasets routes for rename, members, participants, stewards, inheritance (with impact preview) and archive/unarchive. Mutations carry Idempotency-Key and expected generations; missing preconditions 428, stale or reused intent 409, invalid input 400, hidden resources the uniform 404, a known action denied to an authorized reader 403.
Acceptance: real HTTP/PostgreSQL tests for each route's allow, deny, stale-generation and response-loss retry cases; receipts state LocalOnly/Pending/Durable truthfully.
set.title: F02.3.2: Expose governed organization commands over HTTP with ADR 001 error mapping
